english.note: Use this for foam or lather made by mixing soap and water; it is the all-purpose rendering for this sense.

examples.english: Adding a little detergent when doing laundry makes lots of suds.
examples.traditional: 洗衫嗰陣加少少洗衣液，就會有好多肥皂泡沫。
